rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a cultivated plant or its produce.

example.english: This crop was only planted this year.
example.traditional: 呢種農作物今年先至開始種。
example.jyutping: nei1 zung2 nung4 zok3 mat6 gam1 nin4 sin1 zi3 hoi1 ci2 zung2

rows.note: Use this for the amount harvested in a season, not the plant itself.

example.english: This year's rice crop is pretty good.
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 di1 dou6 mai5 sau1 sing4 m4 co3

rows.note: Use this in photography or image editing for a picture after its edges have been removed.

example.english: This is a crop, and it looks much clearer.
example.traditional: 呢張係裁剪咗嘅相，睇落清楚好多。
example.jyutping: nei1 zoeng1 hai6 coi4 zin2 zo2 ge3 soeng2 tai2 lok6 cing1 co2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for the short-hairstyle sense of crop.

example.english: I got a crop, so I save a lot of time in the morning.
example.traditional: 我剪咗短髮，朝早慳好多時間。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zin2 zo2 dyun2 faat3 ziu1 zou2 haan1 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3
